prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: []
1: ["Confirm your commitment to caring for your new desktop pet."]
2: ["Find Your Creation Path", "Answer a few quick questions to match with the best creation path."]
3: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion", "Your pet is now active! Here is how to control, interact, and manage your pet.", "Click pet to open options menu", "Drag pet to relocate on screen"]
4: ["For best pet rendering results, upload clear, well-lit photos with full face visibility."]
5: ["Creating Your Desktop Pet", "We are generating your custom desktop animations. This will take just a moment!", "Estimated build time", "Tip: You can customize pet behavior anytime from your desktop taskbar."]
6: ["Secure Your Pet Data", "Signing in syncs your companion safe to the cloud so your pet is never reset or lost when re-installing."]
7: ["Welcome to Desktop Companions", "Scroll through to see how interactive desktop pets bring your screen to life."]
8: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Congratulations on completing your companion setup!", "Certified Desktop Pet Parent"]
9: ["Enable desktop updates to receive new pet interaction guides and companion features."]

verdicts.problem: Asks for personal information by requesting photos with face visibility.
